title: Bayonetta
shortDescription: Hideki Kamiya and PlatinumGames' flamboyant character action combat pinnacle, starring the shapeshifting Umbra Witch Bayonetta.
historicalSignificance: Set the gold standard for high-speed character action combat, introducing the iconic 'Witch Time' dodge mechanic, 60 FPS acrobatic choreography, and establishing PlatinumGames as the world's premier action studio.

editorialContent.overview: Directed by Devil May Cry creator Hideki Kamiya, players control Bayonetta, an amnesiac Umbra Witch awakened after a 500-year slumber who wields four handguns mounted to her hands and high heels against celestial angelic legions.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pinnacle combo mechanics centered around 'Witch Time'—dodging an incoming attack at the last possible microsecond slows time to a crawl, enabling devastating Wicked Weaves hair summons and cinematic Torture Attacks.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Delivered flawless 60 FPS combat choreography on Xbox 360, featuring dynamic camera angles, seamless weapon swapping mid-combo, and extravagant hair physics.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Bayonetta became one of the most iconic and unapologetically stylish heroines in video game history, later starring in Super Smash Bros.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on physical media and remastered in 4K 60 FPS on modern consoles and PC.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 2 million copies sold across versions

technicalSpecs.resolution: 720p at locked 60fps (Xbox 360) / 4K on PC and modern consoles
technicalSpecs.soundChip: Dolby Digital 5.1 with 'Fly Me to the Moon' jazz arrangements
